question: Identify the short names of teams that, in any 2015 attribute record, had a 'Normal' build-up play dribbling class and a chance creation passing score below the average for all teams with 'Normal' build-up play dribbling in 2015. Among these teams, return only those whose associated leagues (via matches played in the 2015/2016 season) ranked among the bottom 3 leagues by total goals scored.

prediction.sql:
WITH normal_2015 AS (
  SELECT XCL_177 AS team_id, XCL_186 AS ccp
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE strftime('%Y', XCL_178) = '2015' AND XCL_182 = 'Normal'
),
avg_ccp AS (
  SELECT AVG(ccp) AS a FROM normal_2015
),
below AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT n.team_id
  FROM normal_2015 n CROSS JOIN avg_ccp ac
  WHERE n.ccp < ac.a
),
league_goals AS (
  SELECT m.XCL_008 AS league_id, SUM(m.XCL_015) + SUM(m.XCL_016) AS total_goals
  FROM Match m
  WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY m.XCL_008
),
bottom3 AS (
  SELECT league_id FROM league_goals ORDER BY total_goals ASC LIMIT 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_174
FROM below b
JOIN Team t ON t.XCL_171 = b.team_id
JOIN Match m ON m.XCL_013 = t.XCL_171 OR m.XCL_014 = t.XCL_171
JOIN bottom3 bl ON bl.league_id = m.XCL_008
WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH NormalTeams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ta.XCL_177 AS team_id,
        t.XCL_173 AS short_name,
        ta.XCL_181 AS chance_creation_passing
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN Team t ON ta.XCL_177 = t.XCL_171
    WHERE ta.XCL_178 LIKE '2015%'
      AND ta.XCL_180 = 'Normal'
),
AvgPassing AS (
    SELECT AVG(chance_creation_passing) AS avg_passing
    FROM NormalTeams
),
FilteredTeams AS (
    SELECT nt.team_id, nt.short_name
    FROM NormalTeams nt
    CROSS JOIN AvgPassing ap
    WHERE nt.chance_creation_passing < ap.avg_passing
),
LeagueGoals AS (
    SELECT
        m.XCL_007 AS league_id,
        SUM(m.XCL_010 + m.XCL_011) AS total_goals
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.XCL_009 LIKE '2015/2016%'
    GROUP BY m.XCL_007
),
RankedLeagues AS (
    SELECT
        league_id,
        total_goals,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_goals ASC) AS goal_rank
    FROM LeagueGoals
),
Bottom3Leagues AS (
    SELECT league_id
    FROM RankedLeagues
    WHERE goal_rank <= 3
),
TeamLeagues AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ft.team_id,
        ft.short_name,
        m.XCL_007 AS league_id
    FROM FilteredTeams ft
    JOIN Match m ON ft.team_id = m.XCL_013 OR ft.team_id = m.XCL_014
    WHERE m.XCL_009 LIKE '2015/2016%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    tl.short_name
FROM TeamLeagues tl
JOIN Bottom3Leagues b3 ON tl.league_id = b3.league_id
